example_en: My goal is to learn Chinese.

example_zh: 我们旅行的目的是了解文化。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen lǚxíng de mùdì shì liǎojiě wénhuà.
example_en: The purpose of our trip is to learn about the culture.
example_cloze: 我们旅行的＿＿是了解文化。

example_zh: 火车很快就到目的地了。
example_pinyin: Huǒchē hěn kuài jiù dào mùdìdì le.
example_en: The train soon reached its destination.

en: at present; currently; at the moment
example_zh: 目前他在中国学习。
example_pinyin: Mùqián tā zài Zhōngguó xuéxí.
example_en: At present he is studying in China.

example_zh: 老师对学生很有耐心。
example_pinyin: Lǎoshī duì xuéshēng hěn yǒu nàixīn.
example_en: The teacher is very patient with the students.

example_zh: 这位男士是做什么工作的？
example_pinyin: Zhè wèi nánshì shì zuò shénme gōngzuò de?
example_en: What does this gentleman do for a living?

example_zh: 这项运动男性也可以参加。
example_pinyin: Zhè xiàng yùndòng nánxìng yě kěyǐ cānjiā.
example_en: Men can also take part in this sport.

example_zh: 城市的南部有一个公园。
example_pinyin: Chéngshì de nánbù yǒu yì ge gōngyuán.
example_en: There is a park in the south of the city.

example_zh: 难道你不知道这件事吗？
example_pinyin: Nándào nǐ bù zhīdào zhè jiàn shì ma?
example_en: Could it be that you don't know about this?

example_zh: 他今天有点儿难受。
example_pinyin: Tā jīntiān yǒudiǎnr nánshòu.
example_en: He feels a bit unwell today.

example_zh: 这是难忘的一天。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì nánwàng de yì tiān.
example_en: This is an unforgettable day.

example_zh: 图书馆内很安静。
example_pinyin: Túshūguǎn nèi hěn ānjìng.
example_en: It is very quiet inside the library.

example_zh: 这本书的内容很有意思。
example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū de nèiróng hěn yǒu yìsi.
example_en: The content of this book is very interesting.

example_zh: 他的内心很安静。
example_pinyin: Tā de nèixīn hěn ānjìng.
example_en: His heart is very calm.

en: whether or not one can; can or cannot
example_zh: 你能否帮我拿一下行李？
example_pinyin: Nǐ néngfǒu bāng wǒ ná yíxià xíngli?
example_en: Could you help me carry my luggage?

en: to be able to; to be capable of; can
example_zh: 他能够自己完成作业。
example_pinyin: Tā nénggòu zìjǐ wánchéng zuòyè.
example_en: He is able to finish the homework by himself.

example_zh: 他的汉语能力提高很快。
example_pinyin: Tā de Hànyǔ nénglì tígāo hěn kuài.
example_en: His Chinese ability is improving fast.

example_zh: 嗯，好的，我知道了。
example_pinyin: Èn, hǎo de, wǒ zhīdào le.
example_en: Mm-hm, okay, I see.

example_zh: 年底大家都很忙。
example_pinyin: Niándǐ dàjiā dōu hěn máng.
example_en: Everyone is busy at the end of the year.

example_zh: 他的年龄比妹妹大五岁。
example_pinyin: Tā de niánlíng bǐ mèimei dà wǔ suì.
example_en: He is five years older than his younger sister.

example_zh: 他从小在农村长大。
example_pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo zài nóngcūn zhǎngdà.
example_en: He grew up in the countryside.

en: to handle; to do; to fix; to play with (弄)
example_zh: 请把这个坏了的电脑弄好。
example_pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhège huài le de diànnǎo nònghǎo.
example_en: Please fix this broken computer.
example_cloze: 请把这个坏了的电脑＿＿好。

example_zh: 这项工作女性也可以做。
example_pinyin: Zhè xiàng gōngzuò nǚxìng yě kěyǐ zuò.
example_en: Women can also do this job.

en: warm; nice and warm; to warm up
example_zh: 春天的天气很暖和。
example_pinyin: Chūntiān de tiānqì hěn nuǎnhuo.
example_en: The weather in spring is very warm.

en: occasionally; once in a while; accidental
example_zh: 他偶尔去电影院看电影。
example_pinyin: Tā ǒu'ěr qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng.
example_en: He occasionally goes to the cinema.

en: to clap; to pat; to take (a photo); to film (拍)
example_zh: 孩子们在球场上拍球。
example_pinyin: Háizimen zài qiúchǎng shàng pāiqiú.
example_en: The children are bouncing balls on the court.

en: row; line (measure); to arrange; to discharge (排)
example_zh: 请按顺序排好队。
example_pinyin: Qǐng àn shùnxù páihǎo duì.
example_en: Please line up in order.

en: to line up; to queue up
example_zh: 买东西的时候要排队。
example_pinyin: Mǎi dōngxi de shíhou yào páiduì.
example_en: You have to queue when shopping.

example_zh: 他们周末去打排球。
example_pinyin: Tāmen zhōumò qù dǎ páiqiú.
example_en: They play volleyball on weekends.

example_zh: 这是一种有名气的牌子。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì yì zhǒng yǒu míngqi de páizi.
example_en: This is a well-known brand.

example_zh: 我喜欢这个牌子的鞋。
example_pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zhège páizi de xié.
example_en: I like shoes of this brand.

example_zh: 你判断一下这个答案对不对。
example_pinyin: Nǐ pànduàn yíxià zhège dá'àn duì bú duì.
example_en: Judge whether this answer is right or not.
example_cloze: 你＿＿一下这个答案对不对。

example_zh: 我陪妈妈去医院。
example_pinyin: Wǒ péi māma qù yīyuàn.
example_en: I'll accompany Mom to the hospital.

example_zh: 老师批评了迟到的学生。
example_pinyin: Lǎoshī pīpíngle chídào de xuéshēng.
example_en: The teacher criticized the students who were late.

example_zh: 她的皮肤很干净。
example_pinyin: Tā de pífū hěn gānjìng.
example_en: Her skin is very clean.

example_zh: 上班的时候要穿皮鞋。
example_pinyin: Shàngbān de shíhou yào chuān píxié.
example_en: You should wear leather shoes at work.

example_zh: 他的脾气很好。
example_pinyin: Tā de píqi hěn hǎo.
example_en: He has a very good temper.

example_zh: 他写了一篇文章。
example_pinyin: Tā xiěle yì piān wénzhāng.
example_en: He wrote an article.

en: measure for flat things; slice; film (片)
example_zh: 盘子里有两片面包。
example_pinyin: Pánzi lǐ yǒu liǎng piàn miànbāo.
example_en: There are two slices of bread on the plate.

example_zh: 我喜欢打乒乓球。
example_pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan dǎ pīngpāngqiú.
example_en: I like playing table tennis.

example_zh: 他平常六点起床。
example_pinyin: Tā píngcháng liù diǎn qǐchuáng.
example_en: He usually gets up at six.

en: broken; worn out; torn; to break (破)
example_zh: 这件衣服破了。
example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu pò le.
example_en: These clothes are torn.

example_zh: 我最喜欢吃葡萄。
example_pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī pútao.
example_en: I like eating grapes the most.

example_zh: 这个地区的葡萄酒很有名。
example_pinyin: Zhège dìqū de pútaojiǔ hěn yǒumíng.
example_en: The wine from this region is very famous.

example_zh: 手机的使用现在很普遍。
example_pinyin: Shǒujī de shǐyòng xiànzài hěn pǔbiàn.
example_en: The use of mobile phones is very widespread now.

example_zh: 这是一个普通的城市。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì yì ge pǔtōng de chéngshì.
example_en: This is an ordinary city.

example_zh: 我们上课都说普通话。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen shàngkè dōu shuō pǔtōnghuà.
example_en: We all speak Mandarin in class.

en: period of time; term; issue (of a journal) (期)
example_zh: 这是本杂志的第三期。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì běn zázhì de dì-sān qī.
example_en: This is the third issue of the magazine.

example_zh: 期末考试快到了。
example_pinyin: Qīmò kǎoshì kuài dào le.
example_en: The final exam is coming soon.

example_zh: 期中考试不难。
example_pinyin: Qīzhōng kǎoshì bù nán.
example_en: The midterm exam is not hard.

example_zh: 首先要注意安全，其次要节约时间。
example_pinyin: Shǒuxiān yào zhùyì ānquán, qícì yào jiéyuē shíjiān.
example_en: First pay attention to safety; secondly, save time.
example_cloze: 首先要注意安全，＿＿要节约时间。

en: among them; in which; of which
example_zh: 有很多学生，其中十个是外国人。
example_pinyin: Yǒu hěn duō xuéshēng, qízhōng shí ge shì wàiguórén.
example_en: There are many students, ten of whom are foreigners.
example_cloze: 有很多学生，＿＿十个是外国人。

en: to play (a role); to have (an effect)
example_zh: 锻炼起到了健康的作用。
example_pinyin: Duànliàn qǐdàole jiànkāng de zuòyòng.
example_en: Exercise played a role in his health.

example_zh: 他生气了，不说话。
example_pinyin: Tā shēngqì le, bù shuōhuà.
example_en: He got angry and stopped talking.

example_zh: 这个城市的气候很好。
example_pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de qìhòu hěn hǎo.
example_en: The climate of this city is very pleasant.

example_zh: 今天的气温很低。
example_pinyin: Jīntiān de qìwēn hěn dī.
example_en: The temperature is very low today.

example_zh: 孩子们喜欢喝汽水。
example_pinyin: Háizimen xǐhuan hē qìshuǐ.
example_en: The children love drinking soda.

example_zh: 我买了两千克苹果。
example_pinyin: Wǒ mǎile liǎng qiānkè píngguǒ.
example_en: I bought two kilograms of apples.

en: must (in imperative); by all means; ten million (千万)
example_zh: 千万要记住我的电话号码。
example_pinyin: Qiānwàn yào jìzhù wǒ de diànhuà hàomǎ.
example_en: Do remember my phone number.

en: visa; to apply for a visa
example_zh: 他去外国前要办签证。
example_pinyin: Tā qù wàiguó qián yào bàn qiānzhèng.
example_en: He needs to get a visa before going abroad.

en: ahead; ahead of one; the front
example_zh: 前方路口有红绿灯。
example_pinyin: Qiánfāng lùkǒu yǒu hóng-lǜdēng.
example_en: There is a traffic light at the intersection ahead.

en: around (a time); front and back; before and after
example_zh: 考试前后他都很紧张。
example_pinyin: Kǎoshì qiánhòu tā dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
example_en: He was nervous both before and after the exam.

en: strong; powerful; better; to make an effort (强)
example_zh: 他的力气很大，比以前强多了。
example_pinyin: Tā de lìqi hěn dà, bǐ yǐqián qiáng duō le.
example_en: He is much stronger than before; very strong.
example_cloze: 他的力气很大，比以前＿＿多了。

en: to knock; to strike; to knock out
example_zh: 有人在轻轻敲门。
example_pinyin: Yǒu rén zài qīngqīng qiāo mén.
example_en: Somebody is knocking gently at the door.

example_zh: 河上有一座桥。
example_pinyin: Hé shàng yǒu yí zuò qiáo.
example_en: There is a bridge over the river.

example_zh: 真巧，我们又见面了。
example_pinyin: Zhēn qiǎo, wǒmen yòu jiànmiàn le.
example_en: What a coincidence — we meet again.

example_zh: 孩子们喜欢吃巧克力。
example_pinyin: Háizimen xǐhuan chī qiǎokèlì.
example_en: The children love eating chocolate.

example_zh: 过年的时候亲戚都来家里。
example_pinyin: Guònián de shíhou qīnqi dōu lái jiā lǐ.
example_en: At New Year all the relatives come to our house.

example_zh: 妹妹在学弹琴。
example_pinyin: Mèimei zài xué tán qín.
example_en: My younger sister is learning to play the piano.

example_zh: 青年人要多学习。
example_pinyin: Qīngnián rén yào duō xuéxí.
example_en: Young people should study more.

example_zh: 这个包很轻，东西很少。
example_pinyin: Zhège bāo hěn qīng, dōngxi hěn shǎo.
example_en: This bag is light; there is little in it.

example_zh: 听完音乐他觉得轻松了。
example_pinyin: Tīng wán yīnyuè tā juéde qīngsōng le.
example_en: After listening to music he felt relaxed.

example_zh: 他的身体情况很好。
example_pinyin: Tā de shēntǐ qíngkuàng hěn hǎo.
example_en: His health condition is very good.

example_zh: 大家庆祝考试成功。
example_pinyin: Dàjiā qìngzhù kǎoshì chénggōng.
example_en: Everyone is celebrating the exam success.

example_zh: 这个球队昨天赢了。
example_pinyin: Zhège qiúduì zuótiān yíngle.
example_en: This team won yesterday.

example_zh: 他是这个球队的球迷。
example_pinyin: Tā shì zhège qiúduì de qiúmí.
example_en: He is a fan of this team.

example_zh: 这个区有很多学校。
example_pinyin: Zhège qū yǒu hěn duō xuéxiào.
example_en: This district has many schools.

example_zh: 这两个词的意思有区别。
example_pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge cí de yìsi yǒu qūbié.
example_en: The meanings of these two words are different.

en: to take; to get; to fetch; to withdraw (取)
example_zh: 我去银行取钱。
example_pinyin: Wǒ qù yínháng qǔ qián.
example_en: I go to the bank to withdraw money.

en: to obtain; to gain; to achieve; to acquire
example_zh: 他在比赛中取得了好成绩。
example_pinyin: Tā zài bǐsài zhōng qǔdéle hǎo chéngjì.
example_en: He achieved good results in the competition.

en: to cancel; to abolish; to call off
example_zh: 因为下雨，会议取消了。
example_pinyin: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, huìyì qǔxiāo le.
example_en: Because of the rain, the meeting was canceled.

example_zh: 全家都去公园了。
example_pinyin: Quán jiā dōu qù gōngyuán le.
example_en: The whole family went to the park.

example_zh: 他把作业全部写完了。
example_pinyin: Tā bǎ zuòyè quánbù xiě wán le.
example_en: He finished all the homework.

example_zh: 同学们全都到了。
example_pinyin: Tóngxuémen quándōu dào le.
example_en: All the classmates have arrived.

example_zh: 这个问题是全球的问题。
example_pinyin: Zhège wèntí shì quánqiú de wèntí.
example_en: This is a global problem.

example_zh: 跑步后他全身都是汗。
example_pinyin: Pǎobù hòu tā quánshēn dōu shì hàn.
example_en: After running he was covered in sweat.

en: to lack; to be short of; to be missing (缺)
example_zh: 他还缺一本书。
example_pinyin: Tā hái quē yì běn shū.
example_en: He still lacks a book.

example_zh: 每个人都有缺点。
example_pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu quēdiǎn.
example_en: Everyone has shortcomings.

en: to lack; to be short of; shortage
example_zh: 这个地区缺少干净的水。
example_pinyin: Zhège dìqū quēshǎo gānjìng de shuǐ.
example_en: This region lacks clean water.

example_zh: 天气很热，他却穿了很多衣服。
example_pinyin: Tiānqì hěn rè, tā què chuānle hěn duō yīfu.
example_en: The weather is hot, yet he wore a lot of clothes.
example_cloze: 天气很热，他＿＿穿了很多衣服。

example_zh: 他确实是最好的学生。
example_pinyin: Tā quèshí shì zuì hǎo de xuéshēng.
example_en: He is indeed the best student.

example_zh: 他学习很努力，然而成绩不好。
example_pinyin: Tā xuéxí hěn nǔlì, rán'ér chéngjì bù hǎo.
example_en: He studies hard; however, his grades are poor.
example_cloze: 他学习很努力，＿＿成绩不好。

example_zh: 市场上的东西很多，很热闹。
example_pinyin: Shìchǎng shàng de dōngxi hěn duō, hěn rènao.
example_en: There are many things at the market; it is bustling.

example_zh: 人生很短，要好好生活。
example_pinyin: Rénshēng hěn duǎn, yào hǎohǎo shēnghuó.
example_en: Life is short; live it well.

example_zh: 参加比赛的人数很多。
example_pinyin: Cānjiā bǐsài de rénshù hěn duō.
example_en: The number of people taking part in the competition is large.

example_zh: 医院的工作人员很辛苦。
example_pinyin: Yīyuàn de gōngzuò rényuán hěn xīnkǔ.
example_en: The hospital staff work very hard.

en: any; every; whichever; no matter what
example_zh: 任何时候都要注意安全。
example_pinyin: Rènhé shíhou dōu yào zhùyì ānquán.
example_en: Pay attention to safety at all times.

example_zh: 今天的任务很多。
example_pinyin: Jīntiān de rènwu hěn duō.
example_en: There are many tasks today.

example_zh: 他把旧报纸扔了。
example_pinyin: Tā bǎ jiù bàozhǐ rēng le.
example_en: He threw away the old newspapers.

example_zh: 他病好了，仍坚持锻炼。
example_pinyin: Tā bìng hǎo le, réng jiānchí duànliàn.
example_en: Though recovered, he still keeps exercising.

example_zh: 他仍然每天跑步。
example_pinyin: Tā réngrán měitiān pǎobù.
example_en: He still goes running every day.

example_zh: 这是我的日常生活。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de rìcháng shēnghuó.
example_en: This is my daily life.

example_zh: 他每天写日记。
example_pinyin: Tā měitiān xiě rìjì.
example_en: He keeps a diary every day.

example_zh: 请在表格上写日期。
example_pinyin: Qǐng zài biǎogé shàng xiě rìqī.
example_en: Please write the date on the form.

example_zh: 他的日子过得很快乐。
example_pinyin: Tā de rìzi guò de hěn kuàilè.
example_en: He leads a very happy life.

en: to enter; to join; to be admitted (入)
example_zh: 他今年考入了大学。
example_pinyin: Tā jīnnián kǎorùle dàxué.
example_en: He was admitted to a university this year.

example_zh: 公园的入口在北边。
example_pinyin: Gōngyuán de rùkǒu zài běibiān.
example_en: The park entrance is on the north side.

en: to start school; to be admitted to a school
example_zh: 孩子们九月入学。
example_pinyin: Háizimen jiǔ yuè rùxué.
example_en: The children start school in September.

en: to check in (a hotel); to move into
example_zh: 他们下午入住酒店。
example_pinyin: Tāmen xiàwǔ rùzhù jiǔdiàn.
example_en: They check into the hotel in the afternoon.

en: to take a walk; to go for a stroll
example_zh: 晚饭后我们去公园散步。
example_pinyin: Wǎnfàn hòu wǒmen qù gōngyuán sànbù.
example_en: After dinner we take a walk in the park.

en: to scan a QR code; to swipe (scan)
example_zh: 进地铁站要先扫码。
example_pinyin: Jìn dìtiězhàn yào xiān sǎomǎ.
example_en: You need to scan a QR code before entering the subway station.

example_zh: 森林里有很多动物。
example_pinyin: Sēnlín lǐ yǒu hěn duō dòngwù.
example_en: There are many animals in the forest.

example_zh: 听到这个消息她很伤心。
example_pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi tā hěn shāngxīn.
example_en: She was very sad to hear the news.

en: to talk over; to consult; to discuss
example_zh: 这件事我们再商量一下。
example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒmen zài shāngliang yíxià.
example_en: Let's discuss this matter again.

example_zh: 这个商店的商品很多。
example_pinyin: Zhège shāngdiàn de shāngpǐn hěn duō.
example_en: This shop has many goods.

en: to visit; to call on; to deliver to the door
example_zh: 医生会上门看病。
example_pinyin: Yīshēng huì shàngmén kànbìng.

example_pinyin: Tā yìshēng dōu zài xuéxiào gōngzuò.
example_en: He worked at schools all his life.

example_zh: 会议已结束，大家回家。
example_pinyin: Huìyì yǐ jiéshù, dàjiā huí jiā.

en: to cause; to lead to; to give rise to; to arouse

example_pinyin: Tā de huà yǐnqǐle dàjiā de tǎolùn.
example_en: His words started a discussion among everyone.

example_en: Our team won this match.

example_pinyin: Tā yíngdéle dàjiā de zhīchí.
example_en: He won everyone's support.

example_pinyin: Tā lái gōngsī yìngpìn fānyì gōngzuò.

example_zh: 他永远忘不了那一天。
example_pinyin: Tā yǒngyuǎn wàng bù liǎo nà yì tiān.
example_en: He will never forget that day.

example_zh: 他是个勇敢的孩子。
example_pinyin: Tā shì ge yǒnggǎn de háizi.
example_en: He is a brave child.

en: so as to use for; to be used for

example_pinyin: Zhège bēizi shì yònglái hē shuǐ de.
example_en: This cup is for drinking water.

en: to be used in; to be used for; to serve as
example_zh: 这笔钱用于学生奖学金。
example_pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián yòngyú xuéshēng jiǎngxuéjīn.
example_en: This money is used for student scholarships.

example_zh: 每个人都有优点和缺点。
example_pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu yōudiǎn hé quēdiǎn.
example_en: Everyone has strengths and weaknesses.

example_zh: 他是一名优秀的学生。
example_pinyin: Tā shì yì míng yōuxiù de xuéshēng.
example_en: He is an outstanding student.

en: humorous; humor; to have a sense of humor
example_zh: 我们的老师很幽默。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen de lǎoshī hěn yōumò.
example_en: Our teacher has a great sense of humor.

example_zh: 他喜欢运动，尤其是跑步。
example_pinyin: Tā xǐhuan yùndòng, yóuqí shì pǎobù.
example_en: He likes sports, running especially.

example_zh: 这个问题由经理决定。
example_pinyin: Zhège wèntí yóu jīnglǐ juédìng.
example_en: This matter is up to the manager to decide.

en: due to; as a result of; thanks to; owing to
example_zh: 由于堵车，他迟到了。
example_pinyin: Yóuyú dǔchē, tā chídào le.
example_en: He was late because of the traffic jam.

en: oil; fat; grease; to apply oil (油)

example_pinyin: Zuò yú de shíhou yào fàng yóu.
example_en: Put oil in when cooking fish.

en: to go sightseeing; to amuse oneself; to have fun
example_zh: 游客们在公园里游玩。
example_pinyin: Yóukèmen zài gōngyuán lǐ yóuwán.
example_en: The tourists are having fun in the park.

example_zh: 这里的人对我们很友好。
example_pinyin: Zhèlǐ de rén duì wǒmen hěn yǒuhǎo.
example_en: The people here are very friendly to us.

example_zh: 他们之间的友情很深。
example_pinyin: Tāmen zhījiān de yǒuqíng hěn shēn.
example_en: The friendship between them is deep.

example_zh: 他们的友谊从小学开始。
example_pinyin: Tāmen de yǒuyì cóng xiǎoxué kāishǐ.
example_en: Their friendship started in primary school.

example_pinyin: Zhè shì yì běn yǒuqù de shū.
example_en: This is an interesting book.

en: effective; valid; to be in effect
example_zh: 这个方法很有效。
example_pinyin: Zhège fāngfǎ hěn yǒuxiào.
example_en: This method is very effective.

example_zh: 这个城市有着很多老房子。
example_pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yǒuzhe hěn duō lǎo fángzi.
example_en: This city has many old buildings.

en: thereupon; hence; consequently; as a result
example_zh: 下雨了，于是我们回家。
example_pinyin: Xià yǔ le, yúshì wǒmen huí jiā.
example_en: It started raining, so we went home.

example_zh: 我们过了一个愉快的周末。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen guòle yì ge yúkuài de zhōumò.
example_en: We had a pleasant weekend.

example_pinyin: Tā yǔ wǒ shāngliangle zhège jìhuà.
example_en: He discussed this plan with me.

example_zh: 汉语的语法不难。
example_pinyin: Hànyǔ de yǔfǎ bù nán.
example_en: Chinese grammar is not hard.

example_zh: 上课前请预习课文。
example_pinyin: Shàngkè qián qǐng yùxí kèwén.
example_en: Please preview the text before class.

en: originally; at first; actually; as it turns out
example_zh: 原来是他打的电话。
example_pinyin: Yuánlái shì tā dǎ de diànhuà.
example_en: So it was he who made the phone call.

en: to forgive; to pardon; to excuse
example_zh: 请原谅我迟到了。
example_pinyin: Qǐng yuánliàng wǒ chídào le.
example_en: Please forgive me for being late.

example_zh: 他迟到的原因是堵车。
example_pinyin: Tā chídào de yuányīn shì dǔchē.
example_en: The reason he was late is the traffic jam.

en: to keep away from; to be far from
example_zh: 我们要远离危险的地方。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào yuǎnlí wēixiǎn de dìfang.
example_en: We should stay away from dangerous places.

example_zh: 院长在办公室开会。
example_pinyin: Yuànzhǎng zài bàngōngshì kāihuì.
example_en: The director is having a meeting in the office.

example_zh: 院子里种了两棵树。
example_pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ zhòngle liǎng kē shù.
example_en: Two trees were planted in the yard.

en: to make an appointment; approximately; to arrange (约)
example_zh: 我们约在车站见面。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen yuē zài chēzhàn jiànmiàn.
example_en: We agreed to meet at the station.

en: appointment; date; to make a date
example_zh: 他周末有一个约会。
example_pinyin: Tā zhōumò yǒu yì ge yuēhuì.
example_en: He has a date this weekend.

example_pinyin: Guòjié de shíhou dàjiā chī yuèbǐng.

example_zh: 这是一年中最好的月份。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì yì nián zhōng zuì hǎo de yuèfèn.
example_en: This is the best month of the year.

example_zh: 阅读能提高汉语水平。
example_pinyin: Yuèdú néng tígāo Hànyǔ shuǐpíng.
example_en: Reading can improve your Chinese level.

example_en: The teacher allows us to use dictionaries.

example_pinyin: Tā měi yuè mǎi liǎng běn zázhì.
example_en: He buys two magazines every month.

example_pinyin: Tā zàicì wènle zhège cí de yìsi.
example_en: He asked again what this word means.

example_pinyin: Zhège wèntí míngtiān zàishuō.
example_en: Let's leave this question until tomorrow.

example_en: He is staying at a friend's home for the time being.

example_pinyin: Zǎochén de kōngqì hěn xīnxiān.
example_en: The air is very fresh in the early morning.

example_pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de zérèn.
example_en: Everyone has their own responsibilities.

en: to increase; to raise; to add; to gain

example_en: The number of cars in the city is growing.

en: true; real; genuine; real; true (真正)

example_pinyin: Yǒu shénme wèntí qǐng zhíjiē wèn wǒ.

example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhídé dú liǎng biàn.
example_en: This book is worth reading twice.

example_pinyin: Nǐ fùmǔ de zhíyè shì shénme?

en: to plant; to grow; to cultivate (种, zhòng)

en: to attach importance to; to value; to think highly of

example_pinyin: Fùmǔ hěn zhòngshì háizi de jiàoyù.

example_pinyin: Xuéxiào zhōuwéi yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn.
example_en: There are many shops around the school.

example_pinyin: Zhè shì yì ge hǎo zhǔyi.
example_en: This is a good idea.

en: to wish; to express good wishes (祝)

example_pinyin: Zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!

example_zh: 祝贺你考试成功。
example_pinyin: Zhùhè nǐ kǎoshì chénggōng.

example_zh: 两家公司达成了协议。
example_pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī dáchéngle xiéyì.
example_en: The two companies reached an agreement.

en: to dress up; to make up; dress and adornment
example_zh: 她今天打扮得很漂亮。
example_pinyin: Tā jīntiān dǎban de hěn piàoliang.
example_en: She is dressed up very prettily today.

en: to pack; to wrap (leftovers); to bundle
example_zh: 吃不完就打包吧。
example_pinyin: Chī bu wán jiù dǎbāo ba.
example_en: If you can't finish it, take it to go.

en: to interrupt; to cut short; to break (a record)
example_zh: 别打断别人说话。
example_pinyin: Bié dǎduàn biérén shuōhuà.
example_en: Don't interrupt people when they speak.

en: to break; to smash; to shatter
example_zh: 他不小心打破了杯子。
example_pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn dǎpòle bēizi.
example_en: He accidentally broke the cup.

en: to ask about; to inquire; to scout
example_zh: 他在打听去车站的路。
example_pinyin: Tā zài dǎting qù chēzhàn de lù.
example_en: He is asking the way to the station.

example_zh: 你要大胆地说汉语。
example_pinyin: Nǐ yào dàdǎn de shuō Hànyǔ.
example_en: You should speak Chinese boldly.

en: mostly; the greater part; for the most part
example_zh: 商店里的顾客大多是年轻人。
example_pinyin: Shāngdiàn lǐ de gùkè dàduō shì niánqīngrén.
example_en: Most of the customers in the shop are young people.
example_cloze: 商店里的顾客＿＿是年轻人。

example_zh: 学校召开了一次大会。
example_pinyin: Xuéxiào zhàokāile yí cì dàhuì.
example_en: The school held a general meeting.

example_zh: 学校大力支持体育活动。
example_pinyin: Xuéxiào dàlì zhīchí tǐyù huódòng.
example_en: The school strongly supports sports activities.

en: auntie (respectful term for an older woman)
example_zh: 大妈在市场买菜。
example_pinyin: Dàmā zài shìchǎng mǎicài.
example_en: The auntie is buying vegetables at the market.

example_zh: 中国南方人多吃大米。
example_pinyin: Zhōngguó nánfāng rén duō chī dàmǐ.
example_en: People in southern China eat more rice.

example_zh: 读书能让大脑更灵活。
example_pinyin: Dúshū néng ràng dànǎo gèng línghuó.
example_en: Reading keeps the brain more agile.

en: a large number of; a batch of; in bulk
example_zh: 大批游客来到了这个城市。
example_pinyin: Dàpī yóukè láidàole zhège chéngshì.
example_en: Large numbers of tourists came to this city.

example_zh: 市中心有很多大厦。
example_pinyin: Shì zhōngxīn yǒu hěn duō dàshà.
example_en: There are many large buildings downtown.

en: great event; major issue; big affair
example_zh: 今天有件大事要宣布。
example_pinyin: Jīntiān yǒu jiàn dàshì yào xuānbù.
example_en: There is something big to announce today.

example_zh: 大象是最大的陆地动物。
example_pinyin: Dàxiàng shì zuì dà de lùdì dòngwù.
example_en: The elephant is the largest land animal.

en: large-scale; large-sized; on a grand scale
example_zh: 这是一个大型购物中心。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge dàxíng gòuwù zhōngxīn.
example_en: This is a large shopping center.

en: uncle (respectful term for an older man)
example_zh: 那位大爷在公园散步。
example_pinyin: Nà wèi dàye zài gōngyuán sànbù.
example_en: That elderly gentleman is taking a walk in the park.

en: to be greater than; larger than
example_zh: 这个数大于那个数。
example_pinyin: Zhège shù dàyú nàge shù.
example_en: This number is greater than that one.

example_zh: 这种汽车很受大众欢迎。
example_pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qìchē hěn shòu dàzhòng huānyíng.
example_en: This kind of car is very popular with the public.

en: to substitute; to take the place of; era (代)
example_zh: 他帮我代了一节课。
example_pinyin: Tā bāng wǒ dàile yì jié kè.
example_en: He taught the class in my place.

en: representative; delegate; to represent; on behalf of
example_zh: 他是学校的学生代表。
example_pinyin: Tā shì xuéxiào de xuéshēng dàibiǎo.
example_en: He is the students' representative of the school.

example_zh: 没有人能代替妈妈。
example_pinyin: Méiyǒu rén néng dàitì māma.
example_en: Nobody can take the place of Mom.

en: to drive; to spur; to bring along
example_zh: 旅游带动了经济发展。
example_pinyin: Lǚyóu dàidòngle jīngjì fāzhǎn.
example_en: Tourism has driven economic development.

example_zh: 这份工作的待遇不错。
example_pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de dàiyù búcuò.
example_en: The pay and conditions of this job are good.

en: to hold (a post); to take on (a role)
example_zh: 他担任了球队的队长。
example_pinyin: Tā dānrènle qiúduì de duìzhǎng.
example_en: He took on the role of team captain.

example_zh: 这张单子要填两份。
example_pinyin: Zhè zhāng dānzi yào tián liǎng fèn.
example_en: This form has to be filled in twice.

en: alone; by oneself; on one's own
example_zh: 他单独住在城外。
example_pinyin: Tā dāndú zhù zài chéngwài.
example_en: He lives alone outside the city.

example_zh: 这家店的品种很单一。
example_pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de pǐnzhǒng hěn dānyī.
example_en: The variety of goods in this shop is very limited.

example_zh: 这个小区有二十个单元。
example_pinyin: Zhège xiǎoqū yǒu èrshí ge dānyuán.
example_en: This residential area has twenty units.

example_zh: 他胆小，不敢一个人在家。
example_pinyin: Tā dǎnxiǎo, bù gǎn yí ge rén zài jiā.
example_en: He is timid and dare not stay home alone.

en: bland; weak (of drink); light (of color); indifferent
example_zh: 这个汤太淡了。
example_pinyin: Zhège tāng tài dàn le.
example_en: This soup is too bland.

en: local; in the locality; the place in question
example_zh: 当地的天气很热。
example_pinyin: Dāngdì de tiānqì hěn rè.
example_en: The weather there is very hot.

en: in those years; then; that very year
example_zh: 当年他家很穷。
example_pinyin: Dāngnián tā jiā hěn qióng.
example_en: In those years his family was poor.

example_zh: 当前的问题是时间不够。
example_pinyin: Dāngqián de wèntí shì shíjiān búgòu.
example_en: The problem at present is lack of time.

en: in; among; in the middle of
example_zh: 教室当中有一张大桌子。
example_pinyin: Jiàoshì dāngzhōng yǒu yì zhāng dà zhuōzi.
example_en: There is a big table in the middle of the classroom.

en: to block; to keep off; to fend off (挡)
example_zh: 大树挡住了阳光。
example_pinyin: Dà shù dǎngzhùle yángguāng.
example_en: The big tree blocked the sunlight.

en: to treat as; to regard as; to work as (当, dàng)
example_zh: 他把房间当办公室用。
example_pinyin: Tā bǎ fángjiān dàng bàngōngshì yòng.
example_en: He uses the room as an office.

en: to treat as; to take for; to view as
example_zh: 他把我当成了好朋友。
example_pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ dàngchéngle hǎo péngyou.
example_en: He took me for a good friend.

en: to treat as; to regard as; to serve as
example_zh: 这本书被当作教材。
example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū bèi dàngzuò jiàocái.
example_en: This book is used as a textbook.

example_zh: 这位导演很有名。
example_pinyin: Zhè wèi dǎoyǎn hěn yǒumíng.
example_en: This director is very famous.

en: to lead to; to bring about; to result in
example_zh: 抽烟会导致严重的疾病。
example_pinyin: Chōuyān huì dǎozhì yánzhòng de jíbìng.
example_en: Smoking can lead to serious illness.

en: to fall; to collapse; to topple (倒, dǎo)
example_zh: 他摔倒在地上。
example_pinyin: Tā shuāidǎo zài dì shàng.
example_en: He fell to the ground.

example_zh: 火车几点到达车站？
example_pinyin: Huǒchē jǐ diǎn dàodá chēzhàn?
example_en: What time does the train arrive at the station?

en: to expire; to fall due; to be due
example_zh: 这本书下个月到期。
example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū xià ge yuè dàoqī.
example_en: This book is due back next month.

example_zh: 他说得很有道理。
example_pinyin: Tā shuō de hěn yǒu dàolǐ.
example_en: What he says makes a lot of sense.

example_zh: 舞台的灯光很漂亮。
example_pinyin: Wǔtái de dēngguāng hěn piàoliang.
example_en: The stage lighting is beautiful.

en: to climb; to ascend; to publish (登)
example_zh: 他登上了那座山。
example_pinyin: Tā dēngshàngle nà zuò shān.
example_en: He climbed to the top of that mountain.

en: to register; to check in; to enter (a name)
example_zh: 入住时请先登记。
example_pinyin: Rùzhù shí qǐng xiān dēngjì.
example_en: Please register first when checking in.

en: to log in; to sign in; to enter
example_zh: 请用密码登录网站。
example_pinyin: Qǐng yòng mìmǎ dēnglù wǎngzhàn.
example_en: Please log in to the website with your password.

en: to wait for; to await; expectation
example_zh: 我们在等待好消息。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen zài děngdài hǎo xiāoxi.
example_en: We are waiting for good news.

example_zh: 请在大厅等候。
example_pinyin: Qǐng zài dàtīng děnghòu.
example_en: Please wait in the hall.

en: to equal; to be equivalent to; to amount to
example_zh: 一加一等于二。
example_pinyin: Yì jiā yì děngyú èr.
example_en: One plus one equals two.

en: to bow one's head; to lower one's head; to yield
example_zh: 他低头看着书。
example_pinyin: Tā dītóu kànzhe shū.
example_en: He is looking down at his book.

example_zh: 他的确很聪明。
example_pinyin: Tā díquè hěn cōngmíng.
example_en: He is indeed very clever.

example_zh: 他们不是敌人，是朋友。
example_pinyin: Tāmen bú shì dírén, shì péngyou.
example_en: They are not enemies; they are friends.

example_zh: 我喜欢地理课。
example_pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan dìlǐ kè.
example_en: I like geography class.

example_zh: 地面上有很多水。
example_pinyin: Dìmiàn shàng yǒu hěn duō shuǐ.
example_en: There is a lot of water on the floor.

example_zh: 这个地区下雨很多。
example_pinyin: Zhège dìqū xià yǔ hěn duō.
example_en: It rains a lot in this area.

example_zh: 他在公司地位很高。
example_pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī dìwèi hěn gāo.
example_en: He has a high position in the company.

en: underground; on the ground floor; subterranean
example_zh: 地下有一家商场。
example_pinyin: Dìxià yǒu yì jiā shāngchǎng.
example_en: There is a shopping mall underground.

example_zh: 昨天夜里发生了地震。
example_pinyin: Zuótiān yè lǐ fāshēngle dìzhèn.
example_en: An earthquake happened last night.

en: to hand over; to pass; to give respectfully
example_zh: 请把盐递给我。
example_pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yán dì gěi wǒ.
example_en: Please pass me the salt.

example_zh: 这些点心很甜。
example_pinyin: Zhèxiē diǎnxin hěn tián.
example_en: These pastries are very sweet.

en: to like (a post); to give a thumbs-up
example_zh: 他为这条消息点赞。
example_pinyin: Tā wèi zhè tiáo xiāoxi diǎnzàn.
example_en: He liked this message.

example_zh: 手机的电池没有电了。
example_pinyin: Shǒujī de diànchí méiyǒu diàn le.
example_en: The phone's battery has run out of power.

example_zh: 他买了一辆电动车。
example_pinyin: Tā mǎile yí liàng diàndòngchē.
example_en: He bought an electric bike.

example_zh: 这家店卖各种电器。
example_pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài gèzhǒng diànqì.
example_en: This shop sells all kinds of electrical appliances.

example_zh: 网购的人越来越多，电商发展很快。
example_pinyin: Wǎnggòu de rén yuèláiyuè duō, diànshāng fāzhǎn hěn kuài.
example_en: More and more people shop online, and e-commerce is growing fast.
example_cloze: 网购的人越来越多，＿＿发展很快。

example_zh: 他在电视台工作。
example_pinyin: Tā zài diànshìtái gōngzuò.
example_en: He works at a TV station.

example_zh: 这本书有电子版。
example_pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu diànzǐbǎn.
example_en: This book has an electronic version.

en: to transfer; to shift; to allocate (调1, diào)
example_zh: 他被调到了新部门。
example_pinyin: Tā bèi diàodàole xīn bùmén.
example_en: He was transferred to a new department.

example_zh: 他们去农村做了调研。
example_pinyin: Tāmen qù nóngcūn zuòle diàoyán.
example_en: They went to the countryside to do field research.

example_zh: 我定期去健身房锻炼。
example_pinyin: Wǒ dìngqī qù jiànshēnfáng duànliàn.
example_en: I go to the gym to work out at regular intervals.

example_zh: 他在火车上丢失了行李。
example_pinyin: Tā zài huǒchē shàng diūshīle xíngli.
example_en: He lost his luggage on the train.

example_zh: 孩子们喜欢看动画。
example_pinyin: Háizimen xǐhuan kàn dònghuà.
example_en: The children love watching cartoons.

example_zh: 这是一个动人的故事。
example_pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge dòngrén de gùshi.
example_en: This is a moving story.

en: to set to work; to touch; to get started
example_zh: 大家动手打扫教室。
example_pinyin: Dàjiā dòngshǒu dǎsǎo jiàoshì.
example_en: Everyone set to work cleaning the classroom.

en: to freeze; to feel very cold; jelly (冻)
example_zh: 冬天河面会冻住。
example_pinyin: Dōngtiān hémiàn huì dòngzhù.
example_en: In winter the river surface freezes over.

example_zh: 墙上有一个洞。
example_pinyin: Qiáng shàng yǒu yí ge dòng.
example_en: There is a hole in the wall.

example_zh: 他喜欢吃豆腐。
example_pinyin: Tā xǐhuan chī dòufu.
example_en: He likes eating tofu.

example_zh: 早饭我喝了豆浆。
example_pinyin: Zǎofàn wǒ hēle dòujiāng.
example_en: I had soybean milk for breakfast.

en: independent; on one's own; to be independent; separately
example_zh: 他要学着独立生活。
example_pinyin: Tā yào xuézhe dúlì shēnghuó.
example_en: He wants to learn to live independently.

example_zh: 这个城市有独特的文化。
example_pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yǒu dútè de wénhuà.
example_en: This city has a unique culture.

example_zh: 他独自去了电影院。
example_pinyin: Tā dúzì qùle diànyǐngyuàn.
example_en: He went to the cinema by himself.

example_zh: 这个词的读音很难。
example_pinyin: Zhège cí de dúyīn hěn nán.
example_en: The pronunciation of this word is hard.

en: to block up; congested; to stop up (堵)
example_zh: 路上很堵，我们迟到了。
example_pinyin: Lùshang hěn dǔ, wǒmen chídào le.
example_en: The road was congested, so we were late.

example_zh: 今天气温三十度。
example_pinyin: Jīntiān qìwēn sānshí dù.
example_en: The temperature today is thirty degrees.

example_zh: 要知道自己的短处。
example_pinyin: Yào zhīdào zìjǐ de duǎnchù.
example_en: You should know your own weak points.

example_zh: 这只是短期的安排。
example_pinyin: Zhè zhǐshì duǎnqī de ānpái.
example_en: This is only a short-term arrangement.

en: to break; to snap; to cut off (断)
example_zh: 杯子摔在地上断了。
example_pinyin: Bēizi shuāi zài dì shàng duàn le.
example_en: The cup fell to the ground and broke.

example_zh: 他把书堆在桌子上。
example_pinyin: Tā bǎ shū duī zài zhuōzi shàng.
example_en: He piled the books on the table.

example_zh: 队伍排得很长。
example_pinyin: Duìwu pái de hěn cháng.
example_en: The line is very long.

example_zh: 对比一下这两张照片。
example_pinyin: Duìbǐ yíxià zhè liǎng zhāng zhàopiàn.
example_en: Compare these two photos.

en: to treat; to handle (a matter); treatment
example_zh: 要友好地对待客人。
example_pinyin: Yào yǒuhǎo de duìdài kèrén.
example_en: Treat guests in a friendly way.

example_zh: 明天的对手很强。
example_pinyin: Míngtiān de duìshǒu hěn qiáng.
example_en: Tomorrow's opponent is very strong.

example_zh: 他还没有找对象。
example_pinyin: Tā hái méiyǒu zhǎo duìxiàng.
example_en: He has not yet looked for a partner.

example_zh: 这辆车能装五吨货。
example_pinyin: Zhè liàng chē néng zhuāng wǔ dūn huò.
example_en: This truck can carry five tons of goods.

example_zh: 院子里开了十朵花。
example_pinyin: Yuànzi lǐ kāile shí duǒ huā.
example_en: Ten flowers have opened in the yard.

en: to hide; to dodge; to avoid (躲)
example_zh: 下雨了，我们躲进商店。
example_pinyin: Xià yǔ le, wǒmen duǒ jìn shāngdiàn.
example_en: It's raining; let's duck into the shop.

example_zh: 他的儿女都在国外。
example_pinyin: Tā de érnǚ dōu zài guówài.
example_en: His children are all abroad.

example_zh: 他买了一辆二手自行车。
example_pinyin: Tā mǎile yí liàng èrshǒu zìxíngchē.
example_en: He bought a secondhand bicycle.

example_zh: 请用手机扫这个二维码。
example_pinyin: Qǐng yòng shǒujī sǎo zhège èrwéimǎ.
example_en: Please scan this QR code with your phone.

en: to publish; to issue; to express (a view)
example_zh: 他在杂志上发表了一篇文章。
example_pinyin: Tā zài zázhì shàng fābiǎole yì piān wénzhāng.
example_en: He published an article in a magazine.
example_cloze: 他在杂志上＿＿了一篇文章。

en: to release; to announce; to issue
example_zh: 公司发布了新的产品。
example_pinyin: Gōngsī fābùle xīn de chǎnpǐn.
example_en: The company released a new product.

example_zh: 这个城市的交通很发达。
example_pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de jiāotōng hěn fādá.
example_en: Transportation in this city is well developed.

en: to give play to; to bring into play; to display
example_zh: 比赛中他发挥得很好。
example_pinyin: Bǐsài zhōng tā fāhuī de hěn hǎo.
example_en: He performed very well in the competition.

example_zh: 造纸是中国的重要发明。
example_pinyin: Zàozhǐ shì Zhōngguó de zhòngyào fāmíng.
example_en: Papermaking is an important Chinese invention.

en: to initiate; to start; to sponsor
example_zh: 同学们发起了环保活动。
example_pinyin: Tóngxuémen fāqǐle huánbǎo huódòng.
example_en: The students initiated an environmental campaign.

en: to speak (at a meeting); statement; speech
example_zh: 会议请每位代表发言。
example_pinyin: Huìyì qǐng měi wèi dàibiǎo fāyán.
example_en: Every representative is asked to speak at the meeting.

example_zh: 他的发音很标准。
example_pinyin: Tā de fāyīn hěn biāozhǔn.
example_en: His pronunciation is very standard.

en: to punish; to penalize; to fine (罚)
example_zh: 迟到要被老师罚。
example_pinyin: Chídào yào bèi lǎoshī fá.
example_en: You'll be punished by the teacher for being late.

example_zh: 超速被罚款两百元。
example_pinyin: Chāosù bèi fákuǎn liǎngbǎi yuán.
example_en: He was fined two hundred yuan for speeding.

example_zh: 法院在市中心。
example_pinyin: Fǎyuàn zài shì zhōngxīn.
example_en: The court is downtown.

example_zh: 他用番茄做了汤。
example_pinyin: Tā yòng fānqié zuòle tāng.
example_en: He made soup with tomatoes.

en: to turn over; to flip through; to translate (翻)

en: to present; to submit; to show (a certain appearance)
example_zh: 他呈上一份报告给经理。
example_pinyin: Tā chéng shàng yí fèn bàogào gěi jīnglǐ。
example_en: He submitted a report to the manager.

example_zh: 他的态度很诚恳，大家都相信他。
example_pinyin: Tā de tàidù hěn chéngkěn， dàjiā dōu xiāngxìn tā。
example_en: His attitude is very sincere, and everyone believes him.
example_cloze: 他的态度很＿＿，大家都相信他。

example_zh: 他带着诚意来道歉。
example_pinyin: Tā dàizhe chéngyì lái dàoqiàn。
example_en: He came to apologize with sincerity.

example_zh: 请接受我最诚挚的感谢。
example_pinyin: Qǐng jiēshòu wǒ zuì chéngzhì de gǎnxiè。
example_en: Please accept my most sincere thanks.

en: to contract for; to undertake a contract
example_zh: 他承包了村里的一片地。
example_pinyin: Tā chéngbāole cūn lǐ de yí piàn de。
example_en: He contracted a piece of land in the village.

en: to take on; to undertake; to receive and continue
example_zh: 这家公司承接了很多大项目。
example_pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chéngjiēle hěn duō dà xiàngmù。
example_en: This company has taken on many large projects.
example_cloze: 这家公司＿＿了很多大项目。

en: to carry; to bear (a load, weight, or meaning)
example_zh: 这座老桥承载着几代人的记忆。
example_pinyin: Zhè zuò lǎo qiáo chéngzàizhe jǐ dài rén de jìyì。
example_en: This old bridge carries the memories of several generations.
example_cloze: 这座老桥＿＿着几代人的记忆。

example_zh: 我们沿着古老的城墙走了很久。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen yánzhe gǔlǎo de chéngqiáng zǒule hěn jiǔ。
example_en: We walked along the ancient city wall for a long time.
example_cloze: 我们沿着古老的＿＿走了很久。

en: clear; transparent; to clarify; to make clear
example_zh: 他站出来澄清了那件事。
example_pinyin: Tā zhàn chūlái chéngqīngle nà jiàn shì。
example_en: He stepped forward and clarified that matter.

en: to show off one's strength; to try to be tough
example_zh: 别逞强了，累了就休息吧。
example_pinyin: Bié chěngqiángle， lèile jiù xiūxi ba。
example_en: Don't try to be tough; rest if you're tired.

example_zh: 请把这些米放在秤上。
example_pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhèxiē mǐ fàng zài chèng shàng。
example_en: Please put this rice on the scale.

en: to eat, drink and be merry; to enjoy life
example_zh: 放假了，大家只想吃喝玩乐。
example_pinyin: Fàngjiàle， dàjiā zhǐ xiǎng chī-hē-wán-lè。
example_en: It's the holiday, and everyone just wants to eat, drink and have fun.

en: to endure hardship; to bear hardships
example_zh: 年轻人要学会吃苦。
example_pinyin: Niánqīng rén yào xuéhuì chīkǔ。
example_en: Young people need to learn to endure hardship.

en: to suffer a loss; to be at a disadvantage
example_zh: 买东西前多问问，免得吃亏。
example_pinyin: Mǎi dōngxi qián duō wèn wèn， miǎnde chīkuī。
example_en: Ask more before buying things, so you don't suffer a loss.

example_zh: 他搬这些箱子有点儿吃力。
example_pinyin: Tā bān zhèxiē xiāngzi yǒudiǎnr chīlì。
example_en: He finds it a bit strenuous to move these boxes.

example_zh: 爷爷年纪大了，反应有些痴呆。
example_pinyin: Yéye niánjì dàle， fǎnyìng yǒuxiē chīdāi。
example_en: Grandpa is old, and his reactions are somewhat slow.
example_cloze: 爷爷年纪大了，反应有些＿＿。

en: to be infatuated with; to be crazy about
example_zh: 他从小痴迷于画画。
example_pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo chīmí yú huà huà。
example_en: He has been crazy about painting since childhood.

example_zh: 他对她一片痴心，一直不变。
example_pinyin: Tā duì tā yí piàn chīxīn， yìzhí bú biàn。
example_en: He is completely devoted to her, and it never changes.

example_zh: 池塘里有几条小鱼。
example_pinyin: Chítáng lǐ yǒu jǐ tiáo xiǎo yú。
example_en: There are a few small fish in the pond.

en: to be well-known; to be famous
example_zh: 这里的茶驰名全国。
example_pinyin: Zhèlǐ de chá chímíng quán guó。
example_en: The tea here is famous throughout the country.

example_zh: 他迟迟没有回我的消息。
example_pinyin: Tā chíchí méiyǒu huí wǒ de xiāoxi。
example_en: He was slow to reply to my message.

example_zh: 年纪大了，他的反应有些迟钝。
example_pinyin: Niánjì dàle， tā de fǎnyìng yǒuxiē chídùn。
example_en: Now that he's older, his reactions are somewhat slow.
example_cloze: 年纪大了，他的反应有些＿＿。

example_zh: 他走路比以前迟缓多了。
example_pinyin: Tā zǒulù bǐ yǐqián chíhuǎn duōle。
example_en: He walks much more slowly than before.

example_zh: 她迟疑了一下，还是答应了。
example_pinyin: Tā chíyíle yíxià， háishi dāyingle。
example_en: She hesitated for a moment, but still agreed.

example_zh: 你迟早会明白我的意思。
example_pinyin: Nǐ chízǎo huì míngbai wǒ de yìsi。
example_en: Sooner or later you'll understand what I mean.

en: to hold; to grasp; to maintain
example_zh: 他手里持着一把雨伞。
example_pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ chízhe yì bǎ yǔ sǎn。
example_en: He is holding an umbrella in his hand.

en: to stay level; to remain unchanged; to be even
example_zh: 这个月的收入与上月持平。
example_pinyin: Zhège yuè de shōurù yǔ shàng yuè chípíng。
example_en: This month's income is level with last month's.

en: to persevere; to keep at it with persistence
example_zh: 学习外语要持之以恒。
example_pinyin: Xuéxí wàiyǔ yào chízhī-yǐhéng。
example_en: Learning a foreign language requires perseverance.

example_zh: 每个人心里的尺度都不一样。
example_pinyin: Měi gè rén xīnlǐ de chǐdù dōu bù yíyàng。
example_en: Everyone's internal standard is different.
example_cloze: 每个人心里的＿＿都不一样。

example_zh: 这件事是他一生的耻辱。
example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shì tā yìshēng de chǐrǔ。
example_en: This matter is the shame of his whole life.

en: to laugh at; to mock; to sneer at
example_zh: 不要耻笑别人的缺点。
example_pinyin: Búyào chǐxiào biérén de quēdiǎn。
example_en: Don't mock other people's shortcomings.

example_zh: 赤道附近一年四季都很热。
example_pinyin: Chìdào fùjìn yì nián sìjì dōu hěn rè。
example_en: Near the equator it is hot all year round.

example_zh: 公司今年出现了财政赤字。
example_pinyin: Gōngsī jīnnián chūxiànle cáizhèng chìzì。
example_en: The company ran a financial deficit this year.

en: to sprint; to make a final push
example_zh: 比赛最后一百米他开始冲刺。
example_pinyin: Bǐsài zuìhòu yì bǎi mǐ tā kāishǐ chōngcì。
example_en: In the last hundred meters of the race he began to sprint.
example_cloze: 比赛最后一百米他开始＿＿。

example_zh: 夏天我们常去海边冲浪。
example_pinyin: Xiàtiān wǒmen cháng qù hǎi biān chōnglàng。
example_en: In summer we often go surfing at the seaside.

en: to rinse; to wash; to flush
example_zh: 请把杯子冲洗干净。
example_pinyin: Qǐng bǎ bēizi chōngxǐ gānjìng。
example_en: Please rinse the cups clean.

en: to collide with; to bump into; to offend
example_zh: 两辆车在路口冲撞了。
example_pinyin: Liǎng liàng chē zài lùkǒu chōngzhuàngle。
example_en: The two cars collided at the intersection.

en: to charge; to fill; to act as; to pretend
example_zh: 我的手机要充一下电。
example_pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī yào chōng yíxià diàn。
example_en: My phone needs to be charged for a bit.

en: to be full of; to be flooded with (usually bad things)
example_zh: 市场上充斥着各种假货。
example_pinyin: Shìchǎng shàng chōngchìzhe gèzhǒng jiǎ huò。
example_en: The market is flooded with all kinds of fake goods.

en: to serve as; to act as; to play the role of
example_zh: 他临时充当我们的翻译。
example_pinyin: Tā línshí chōngdāng wǒmen de fānyì。
example_en: He temporarily served as our interpreter.

example_zh: 他精力充沛，工作很努力。
example_pinyin: Tā jīnglì chōngpèi， gōngzuò hěn nǔlì。
example_en: He is full of energy and works hard.

example_zh: 我们有充裕的时间准备。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen yǒu chōngyù de shíjiān zhǔnbèi。
example_en: We have ample time to prepare.

en: to long for; to look forward to; to yearn for
example_zh: 她憧憬着未来的生活。
example_pinyin: Tā chōngjǐngzhe wèilái de shēnghuó。
example_en: She is longing for her future life.

example_zh: 他克服了重重困难。
example_pinyin: Tā kèfúle chóngchóng kùnnan。
example_en: He overcame numerous difficulties.

en: to overlap; to pile up; overlap
example_zh: 这两张纸重叠在一起了。
example_pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhāng zhǐ chóngdié zài yìqǐle。
example_en: These two sheets of paper are overlapping.

en: to return to; to go back to (a place or state)
example_zh: 他病好后重返学校上课。
example_pinyin: Tā bìng hǎo hòu chóngfǎn xuéxiào shàngkè。
example_en: After recovering, he returned to school for classes.

example_zh: 两条线完全重合，看不出区别。
example_pinyin: Liǎng tiáo xiàn wánquán chónghé， kàn bù chū qūbié。
example_en: The two lines coincide completely; you can't tell them apart.
example_cloze: 两条线完全＿＿，看不出区别。

example_zh: 老师重申了考试的规则。
example_pinyin: Lǎoshī chóngshēnle kǎoshì de guīzé。
example_en: The teacher restated the exam rules.

example_zh: 那个画面又在我眼前重现。
example_pinyin: Nàge huàmiàn yòu zài wǒ yǎnqián chóngxiàn。
example_en: That scene reappeared before my eyes.

example_zh: 公司决定重组这个团队。
example_pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng chóngzǔ zhège tuánduì。
example_en: The company decided to reorganize this team.

example_zh: 帮助别人是一种崇高的行为。
example_pinyin: Bāngzhù biérén shì yì zhǒng chónggāo de xíngwéi。
example_en: Helping others is a noble act.
example_cloze: 帮助别人是一种＿＿的行为。

en: to revere; to hold in deep respect
example_zh: 学生们都很崇敬这位老医生。
example_pinyin: Xuéshēng men dōu hěn chóngjìng zhè wèi lǎo yīshēng。
example_en: The students all deeply respect this old doctor.
example_cloze: 学生们都很＿＿这位老医生。

en: to advocate; to uphold; to value highly
example_zh: 这个民族崇尚和平与自由。
example_pinyin: Zhège mínzú chóngshàng hépíng yǔ zìyóu。
example_en: This people values peace and freedom.

en: to spoil; to pamper; to dote on
example_zh: 奶奶特别宠她的小孙子。
example_pinyin: Nǎinai tèbié chǒng tā de xiǎo sūnzi。
example_en: Grandma really spoils her little grandson.

example_zh: 父母太宠爱孩子并不好。
example_pinyin: Fùmǔ tài chǒng’ài háizi bìng bù hǎo。
example_en: It's not good for parents to pamper their children too much.

en: to spot-check; to make a random inspection
example_zh: 老师今天抽查了我们的作业。
example_pinyin: Lǎoshī jīntiān chōuchále wǒmen de zuòyè。
example_en: The teacher spot-checked our homework today.
example_cloze: 老师今天＿＿了我们的作业。

en: to draw lots; to draw a ballot
example_zh: 比赛前，两队抽签决定顺序。
example_pinyin: Bǐsài qián， liǎng duì chōuqiān juédìng shùnxù。
example_en: Before the match, the two teams drew lots to decide the order.

example_zh: 钥匙就在这个抽屉里面。
example_pinyin: Yàoshi jiù zài zhège chōuti lǐmiàn。
example_en: The keys are right inside this drawer.

en: to sample; to take a sample
example_zh: 医生给病人做了抽样检查。
example_pinyin: Yīshēng gěi bìngrén zuòle chōuyàng jiǎnchá。
example_en: The doctor did a sample test on the patient.

example_zh: 他们之间没有仇，只是误会。
example_pinyin: Tāmen zhījiān méiyǒu chóu， zhǐshì wùhuì。
example_en: There's no hatred between them, just a misunderstanding.
example_cloze: 他们之间没有＿＿，只是误会。

example_zh: 仇恨只会让人更痛苦。
example_pinyin: Chóuhèn zhǐ huì ràng rén gèng tòngkǔ。
example_en: Hatred only makes people suffer more.

example_zh: 多年的仇人终于和好了。
example_pinyin: Duō nián de chóurén zhōngyú héhǎole。
example_en: The enemies of many years finally made peace.

example_zh: 这碗汤太稠了，加点水吧。
example_pinyin: Zhè wǎn tāng tài chóule， jiā diǎn shuǐ ba。
example_en: This soup is too thick; add some water.

example_zh: 这一带人口稠密，房子很多。
example_pinyin: Zhè yídài rénkǒu chóumì， fángzi hěn duō。
example_en: This area is densely populated, with many houses.

en: frowning and worried; wearing a sad, troubled look
example_zh: 他一整天愁眉苦脸，好像有心事。
example_pinyin: Tā yì zhěng tiān chóuméi-kǔliǎn， hǎoxiàng yǒu xīnshì。
example_en: He wore a worried frown all day, as if something was on his mind.

en: to raise (money); to plan; a counter; also: to prepare
example_zh: 他们正在筹钱，想开一家小店。
example_pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài chóu qián， xiǎng kāi yì jiā xiǎo diàn。
example_en: They are raising money and want to open a small shop.
example_cloze: 他们正在＿＿钱，想开一家小店。

en: to prepare; to make arrangements for (an event)
example_zh: 学校正在筹办一场音乐会。
example_pinyin: Xuéxiào zhèngzài chóubàn yì chǎng yīnyuè huì。
example_en: The school is preparing a concert.

example_zh: 公司为这个项目筹措了不少资金。
example_pinyin: Gōngsī wèi zhège xiàngmù chóucuòle bù shǎo zījīn。
example_en: The company raised a lot of funds for this project.
example_cloze: 公司为这个项目＿＿了不少资金。

en: to plan; to make plans for
example_zh: 他们正在筹划明年的旅行。
example_pinyin: Tāmen zhèngzài chóuhuà míngnián de lǚxíng。
example_en: They are planning next year's trip.

example_zh: 大家为生病的同学筹集了一些钱。
example_pinyin: Dàjiā wèi shēngbìng de tóngxué chóujíle yìxiē qián。
example_en: Everyone raised some money for the sick classmate.
example_cloze: 大家为生病的同学＿＿了一些钱。

example_zh: 他手里的筹码不多了。
example_pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ de chóumǎ bù duōle。
example_en: He doesn't have many chips left in his hand.

example_zh: 这部电影揭露了人性丑恶的一面。
example_pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiēlùle rénxìng chǒu’è de yímiàn。
example_en: This movie exposes the ugly side of human nature.
example_cloze: 这部电影揭露了人性＿＿的一面。

example_zh: 这个房子的样子很丑陋。
example_pinyin: Zhège fángzi de yàngzi hěn chǒulòu。
example_en: This house looks very ugly.

example_zh: 那家公司因为丑闻失去了很多客户。
example_pinyin: Nà jiā gōngsī yīnwèi chǒuwén shīqùle hěn duō kèhù。
example_en: That company lost many customers because of the scandal.
example_cloze: 那家公司因为＿＿失去了很多客户。

example_zh: 他往窗外瞅了一眼，外面在下雨。
example_pinyin: Tā wǎng chuāng wài chǒule yì yǎn， wàimiàn zài xià yǔ。
example_en: He glanced out the window; it was raining outside.
example_cloze: 他往窗外＿＿了一眼，外面在下雨。

en: to leave the factory; (of goods) to be produced and shipped
example_zh: 这批手机明天就能出厂。
example_pinyin: Zhè pī shǒujī míngtiān jiù néng chūchǎng。
example_en: This batch of phones can leave the factory tomorrow.

en: to make a fool of oneself; to be disgraced
example_zh: 他怕在大家面前出丑。
example_pinyin: Tā pà zài dàjiā miànqián chūchǒu。
example_en: He is afraid of making a fool of himself in front of everyone.

en: to send out; to dispatch; to turn out (in force)
example_zh: 为了找人，警察出动了很多人。
example_pinyin: Wèile zhǎo rén， jǐngchá chūdòngle hěn duō rén。
example_en: To find the person, the police sent out many people.
example_cloze: 为了找人，警察＿＿了很多人。

en: starting point; point of departure; motive
example_zh: 我们做这件事的出发点是好的。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen zuò zhè jiàn shì de chūfādiǎn shì hǎo de。
example_en: Our motive for doing this is good.
example_cloze: 我们做这件事的＿＿是好的。

en: to visit (a foreign country); to go on an official visit
example_zh: 校长下个月要去外国出访。
example_pinyin: Xiàozhǎng xià gè yuè yào qù wàiguó chūfǎng。
example_en: The principal will go on an official visit abroad next month.

en: to be out; to be eliminated (from a competition)
example_zh: 我们队输了，只好出局。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen duì shūle， zhǐhǎo chūjú。
example_en: Our team lost and had to drop out.

en: to issue; to provide (a document, certificate)
example_zh: 办手续时，你需要出具身份证明。
example_pinyin: Bàn shǒuxù shí， nǐ xūyào chūjù shēnfènzhèng míng。
example_en: When going through the procedures, you need to provide proof of identity.
example_cloze: 办手续时，你需要＿＿身份证明。

en: to speak in an elegant, well-formed way; to have a gift for speaking
example_zh: 他读书多，说话出口成章。
example_pinyin: Tā dúshū duō， shuōhuà chūkǒu-chéngzhāng。
example_en: He has read a lot and speaks elegantly.

example_zh: 只要肯努力，总会有出路的。
example_pinyin: Zhǐyào kěn nǔlì， zǒng huì yǒu chūlù de。
example_en: As long as you're willing to work hard, there will always be a way out.

example_zh: 他为了钱出卖了朋友。
example_pinyin: Tā wèile qián chūmàile péngyou。
example_en: He betrayed his friend for money.

en: to appear personally; to come forward (on behalf of others)
example_zh: 这件事得请经理出面解决。
example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de qǐng jīnglǐ chūmiàn jiějué。
example_en: We need to ask the manager to step in and settle this.

example_zh: 这个结果真的出人意料。
example_pinyin: Zhège jiéguǒ zhēn de chūrényìliào。
example_en: This result is really unexpected.

en: to take up the post of; to serve as
example_zh: 她去年出任公司总经理。
example_pinyin: Tā qùnián chūrèn gōngsī zǒng jīnglǐ。
example_en: She took up the post of general manager of the company last year.

en: family background; to come from (a social class)
example_zh: 他出身农村，从小就很能吃苦。
example_pinyin: Tā chūshēn nóngcūn， cóngxiǎo jiù hěn néng chīkǔ。
example_en: He comes from a rural family and has been able to endure hardship since childhood.
example_cloze: 他＿＿农村，从小就很能吃苦。

en: to be lost in thought; to be spellbound
example_zh: 他听音乐听得出神了。
example_pinyin: Tā tīng yīnyuè tīng de chū shénle。
example_en: He was so lost in the music that he was spellbound.

en: to act; to make a move; (of money) to spend generously
example_zh: 他出手很快，一下就做完了。
example_pinyin: Tā chūshǒu hěn kuài， yíxià jiù zuò wánle。
example_en: He acted quickly and finished it in no time.

example_en: He is willing to take on this important role.

example_en: Young people must shoulder the responsibilities of the family.

example_cloze: 请问这种水果的＿＿是多少？

example_zh: 他到现在还是单身。

example_en: He is still single up to now.

en: to delay; to hold up; to waste (time)
example_zh: 路上堵车，耽搁了不少时间。
example_pinyin: Lùshang dǔchē， dāngele bù shǎo shíjiān。
example_en: There was a traffic jam on the way and it delayed us quite a bit of time.

example_zh: 他的胆量真大，敢一个人走夜路。
example_pinyin: Tā de dǎnliàng zhēn dà， gǎn yí gè rén zǒu yè lù。
example_en: He really has guts, daring to walk the night road alone.

example_zh: 第一次上台，她有点胆怯。
example_pinyin: Dì yī cì shàngtái， tā yǒu diǎn dǎnqiè。
example_en: The first time on stage, she was a bit timid.

example_pinyin: Bié dāng dǎnxiǎoguǐ， kuài qù shì shì！
example_en: Don't be a coward; go and give it a try!

example_zh: 但愿明天是个好天气。
example_pinyin: Dànyuàn míngtiān shì gè hǎo tiānqì。
example_en: I hope tomorrow will be nice weather.

en: carrying pole and loads; load (measure word for carried loads)
example_zh: 他挑着一担水走回家。
example_pinyin: Tā tiāozhe yí dàn shuǐ zǒu huí jiā。
example_en: He carried a load of water home on a pole.

example_zh: 当爸爸以后，他的担子更重了。

example_en: After becoming a father, his burden became heavier.
example_cloze: 当爸爸以后，他的＿＿更重了。

en: birthday (of a respected person); birth anniversary

example_pinyin: Jīnnián shì tā yì bǎi suì de dànchén。
example_en: This year is the hundredth anniversary of his birth.

en: to weaken; to fade; to play down
example_zh: 时间久了，这些记忆慢慢淡化了。
example_pinyin: Shíjiān jiǔle， zhèxiē jìyì màn màn dànhuàle。
example_en: As time went on, these memories gradually faded.

example_zh: 这里淡水很少，大家要节约。
example_pinyin: Zhèlǐ dànshuǐ hěn shǎo， dàjiā yào jiéyuē。
example_en: There is very little fresh water here, so everyone should save it.

en: to make a prompt decision; to decide on the spot
example_zh: 情况紧急，他当机立断，马上出发。
example_pinyin: Qíngkuàng jǐnjí， tā dāngjī-lìduàn， mǎshàng chūfā。
example_en: The situation was urgent, so he made a prompt decision and set off at once.

example_zh: 听到这个消息，他当即决定回家。
example_pinyin: Tīng dào zhège xiāoxi， tā dāngjí juédìng huí jiā。
example_en: Hearing this news, he immediately decided to go home.
example_cloze: 听到这个消息，他＿＿决定回家。

example_zh: 当日天气很好，我们玩得很开心。
example_pinyin: Dāngrì tiānqì hěn hǎo， wǒmen wán de hěn kāixīn。
example_en: The weather that day was great, and we had a lot of fun.

example_zh: 这件事要问当事人才能清楚。
example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yào wèn dāngshìrén cáinéng qīngchu。
example_en: You have to ask the person involved to understand this matter.

en: urgent task at hand; top priority
example_zh: 现在找住的地方是当务之急。
example_pinyin: Xiànzài zhǎo zhù de dìfāng shì dāngwùzhījí。
example_en: Finding a place to stay is the top priority right now.

en: to be careful; to watch out
example_zh: 路上车多，你开车要当心。
example_pinyin: Lùshang chē duō， nǐ kāichē yào dāngxīn。
example_en: There are many cars on the road, so be careful when you drive.

en: to be fully worthy of; to deserve without doubt
example_zh: 她是最好的老师，得奖当之无愧。
example_pinyin: Tā shì zuìhǎo de lǎoshī， de jiǎng dāngzhīwúkuì。

example_zh: 他当众向女朋友道歉。

example_zh: 这个国家的党很多，意见也不一样。
example_pinyin: Zhège guójiā de dǎng hěn duō， yìjiàn yě bù yíyàng。
example_en: This country has many parties, and their views differ.
example_cloze: 这个国家的＿＿很多，意见也不一样。

example_zh: 我只是开玩笑，你别当真。
example_pinyin: Wǒ zhǐshì kāi wánxiào， nǐ bié dàngzhēn。
example_en: I was only joking, so don't take it seriously.

en: to ripple; to undulate; to flutter
example_zh: 微风中，湖面轻轻荡漾。

example_cloze: 这家饭店的＿＿很高，价格也贵。

example_zh: 电视上说，那个国家试了一种新导弹。
example_pinyin: Diànshì shàng shuō， nàge guójiā shìle yì zhǒng xīn dǎodàn。
example_en: The news said that country tested a new kind of missile.
example_cloze: 电视上说，那个国家试了一种新＿＿。

example_zh: 手机导航带我找到了那家书店。

example_en: The phone navigation led me to that bookstore.
example_cloze: 手机＿＿带我找到了那家书店。

en: fuse; spark that triggers a conflict

example_pinyin: Yí jù wán xiàohua chéngle tāmen chǎojià de dǎohuǒsuǒ。

example_zh: 海上有很多小岛屿，风景很美。
example_pinyin: Hǎi shàng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo dǎoyǔ， fēngjǐng hěn měi。

example_en: The preparations for this event were very thorough, and everyone was satisfied.
example_cloze: 这次活动的准备很＿＿，大家都很满意。

example_zh: 离出发只剩三天，我们开始倒计时了。

example_cloze: 离出发只剩三天，我们开始＿＿了。

example_pinyin: Tāmen yòngle liǎng tiān cái chénggōng dēngdǐng。
example_en: It took them two days to successfully reach the summit.

example_en: He pedals his bike to work.

example_zh: 请把那把凳子搬到桌子旁边。

example_en: Please move that stool next to the table.
example_cloze: 请把那把＿＿搬到桌子旁边。

example_zh: 他生气地瞪了我一眼。

example_en: Don't underestimate the difficulty of this task.

example_pinyin: Tā de shìyè xiànzài zhèng chù zài dīgǔ。
example_en: His career is at a low point right now.

example_pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tā xīnqíng yǒu diǎn dīluò。

example_pinyin: Hé shuǐ shàngzhǎng， rén men jiā gāole dī。
example_en: The river rose, so people raised the dike.

example_pinyin: Dà yǔ guòhòu， dībà xūyào jiǎnchá。
example_en: After the heavy rain, the dam needs to be checked.

en: to guard against; to be on the lookout for
example_zh: 出门在外，要提防小偷。
example_pinyin: Chūmén zài wài， yào dīfang xiǎo tōu。
example_en: When you're out and about, you should be on guard against thieves.

en: to be hostile toward; to view with hostility
example_zh: 他一直敌视新来的同事。
example_pinyin: Tā yìzhí díshì xīn lái de tóngshì。

en: to call oneself; to claim to be; self-styled

en: ancestral home; place of family origin
example_zh: 他的祖籍在南方的一个小城。
example_pinyin: Tā de zǔjí zài nánfāng de yí gè xiǎo chéng。
example_en: His family's ancestral home is a small town in the south.
example_cloze: 他的＿＿在南方的一个小城。

example_zh: 祖母常常给我讲她小时候的事。
example_pinyin: Zǔmǔ chángcháng gěi wǒ jiǎng tā xiǎoshíhou de shì。
example_en: My grandmother often tells me stories about when she was little.

example_zh: 过年时，人们会想起自己的祖宗。
example_pinyin: Guònián shí， rén men huì xiǎng qǐ zìjǐ de zǔzong。
example_en: At New Year, people think of their ancestors.
example_cloze: 过年时，人们会想起自己的＿＿。

en: to exploit a loophole; to take advantage of a gap
example_zh: 有人钻空子，少交了不少钱。
example_pinyin: Yǒu rén zuān kòngzi， shǎo jiāole bù shǎo qián。
example_en: Someone exploited a loophole and paid much less.

en: to study deeply; to dig into; to research
example_zh: 他喜欢钻研历史，常常忘了吃饭。
example_pinyin: Tā xǐhuan zuānyán lìshǐ， chángcháng wàngle chī fàn。
example_en: He loves digging into history and often forgets to eat.
example_cloze: 他喜欢＿＿历史，常常忘了吃饭。

example_zh: 她手上戴着一枚钻石戒指。
example_pinyin: Tā shǒu shàng dàizhe yì méi zuànshí jièzhi。
example_en: She is wearing a diamond ring on her hand.

example_zh: 天气太干，他的嘴唇都裂了。
example_pinyin: Tiānqì tài gàn， tā de zuǐchún dōu lièle。
example_en: The weather is so dry that his lips have cracked.

example_zh: 警察很快就抓住了那个罪犯。
example_pinyin: Jǐngchá hěn kuài jiù zhuā zhùle nàge zuìfàn。
example_en: The police caught that criminal quickly.
example_cloze: 警察很快就抓住了那个＿＿。

en: chief culprit; main cause of the trouble
example_zh: 这场大火的罪魁祸首是一个烟头。
example_pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà huǒ de zuìkuí-huòshǒu shì yí gè yān tóu。
example_en: The chief culprit of this big fire was a cigarette butt.
example_cloze: 这场大火的＿＿是一个烟头。

example_zh: 这位尊贵的客人坐在最前面。
example_pinyin: Zhè wèi zūnguì de kèrén zuò zài zuì qiánmiàn。
example_en: This distinguished guest sits at the very front.
example_cloze: 这位＿＿的客人坐在最前面。

example_zh: 每个人都应该有自己的尊严。
example_pinyin: Měi gè rén dōu yīnggāi yǒu zìjǐ de zūnyán。
example_en: Everyone should have their own dignity.
example_cloze: 每个人都应该有自己的＿＿。

example_zh: 我们要遵循学校的规定。
example_pinyin: Wǒmen yào zūnxún xuéxiào de guīdìng。
example_en: We must follow the school's rules.

en: to obey; to act according to
example_zh: 请遵照医生的建议休息。
example_pinyin: Qǐng zūnzhào yīshēng de jiànyì xiūxi。
example_en: Please rest according to the doctor's advice.

example_zh: 他一直在琢磨这个问题。
example_pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài zuómo zhège wèntí。
example_en: He has been thinking over this problem all along.

en: to look around; to glance left and right
example_zh: 她站在门口左顾右盼，像在等人。
example_pinyin: Tā zhàn zài ménkǒu zuǒgù-yòupàn， xiàng zài děng rén。
example_en: She stood at the door looking around, as if waiting for someone.

en: to cheat (in an exam or game)
example_zh: 考试的时候不能作弊。
example_pinyin: Kǎoshì de shíhou bù néng zuòbì。
example_en: You must not cheat during an exam.

en: to oppose; to go against; to be at odds with
example_zh: 他总跟我作对，真让人头疼。
example_pinyin: Tā zǒng gēn wǒ zuòduì， zhēn ràng rén tóu téng。
example_en: He always opposes me; it really gives me a headache.

en: to become invalid; to cancel; to void
example_zh: 这张票过期就作废了。
example_pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào guòqī jiù zuòfèile。
example_en: This ticket becomes invalid once it expires.

en: style of work; way of doing things; conduct
example_zh: 他的工作作风很认真。
example_pinyin: Tā de gōngzuò zuòfēng hěn rènzhēn。
example_en: His work style is very serious.

en: to be a guest; to visit as a guest
example_zh: 周末我们去朋友家作客。
example_pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen qù péngyou jiā zuòkè。
example_en: On the weekend we go to a friend's home as guests.

example_zh: 做这道菜要放几种作料。
example_pinyin: Zuò zhè dào cài yào fàng jǐ zhǒng zuòliao。
example_en: Making this dish requires adding a few kinds of seasoning.

example_zh: 作为学生，我们应该努力学习。
example_pinyin: Zuòwéi xuéshēng， wǒmen yīnggāi nǔlì xuéxí。
example_en: As students, we should study hard.

example_zh: 这里的作物长得很好。
example_pinyin: Zhèlǐ de zuòwù zhǎng de hěn hǎo。
example_en: The crops here are growing very well.

en: to work and rest; daily routine
example_zh: 他的作息很有规律。
example_pinyin: Tā de zuòxī hěn yǒu guīlǜ。
example_en: His daily routine is very regular.

example_zh: 士兵们勇敢地作战。
example_pinyin: Shìbīng men yǒnggǎn de zuòzhàn。
example_en: The soldiers fought bravely.

en: to be located; to sit (of a building or place)
example_zh: 这座学校坐落在山脚下。
example_pinyin: Zhè zuò xuéxiào zuòluò zài shān jiǎo xià。
example_en: This school is located at the foot of the mountain.

en: to have a discussion; to hold an informal meeting
example_zh: 下午老师和家长一起座谈。
example_pinyin: Xiàwǔ lǎoshī hé jiāzhǎng yìqǐ zuòtán。
example_en: In the afternoon the teachers and parents have a discussion together.

example_zh: 他的座右铭是“努力就有希望”。
example_pinyin: Tā de zuòyòumíng shì“ nǔlì jiù yǒu xīwàng”。
example_en: His motto is "Where there is effort, there is hope."

example_zh: 他愿意为这件事做证。
example_pinyin: Tā yuànyì wèi zhè jiàn shì zuòzhèng。
example_en: He is willing to testify about this matter.

en: to decide; to take charge; to have the final say
example_zh: 这件事你来做主吧。
example_pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ lái zuòzhǔ ba。
example_en: You decide this matter.
